title: PDU session types
text: The following PDU Session types are supported
d) Ethernet (EtherType as defined in IEEEStd802.3[31A]); and
IP address allocation for IPv4, IPv6 and IPv4v6 PDU session types is described in subclause6.2.4
Neither a MAC nor an IP address is allocated by the 5GCN to the UE for Ethernet PDU session type
